issuers.notes: sbicard.com card listing is a JS app; the data it loads, https://www.sbicard.com/json/templatedata/cards-catalog-en.json (68 cards, the site's own data request seen in the page's network log), was read with plain GET, plus each card's product JSON, the KFS PDF (title 'SBI Card_Key fact Statement for 14OCT2026') and MITC PDF ('MITC- Common-30OCT26'). One probe of a guessed path under /en/templatedata returned HTTP 490 (firewall) and was not retried or worked around. Catalogue 'sold' = Apply Now / isOnline=yes. Cards with only See Benefits (isOnline=no) are marked unknown: the page FAQ says partner-bank cards are applied for at the partner bank branch; only the two Air India cards say discontinued (10 Oct 2024). KFS/MITC-only rows are cards serviced but not in the catalogue; status unknown. offered_count 99 = 68 catalogue entries + 31 cards found only in the KFS or MITC fee tables. Nature's Basket x2 and Central Bank of India ELITE appear in both matched_live (KFS rows) and stale_live (flagged WEAK because the 30 Oct 2026 MITC and the catalogue dropped them); count them once. Corporate/commercial SBI cards are not in the retail listing and were not read. Live slugs state-bank-of-india/bank-of-maharashtra-simplysave-sbi-card and the hdfc-filed tata-neu-infinity-sbi-credit-card are matched here. Catalogue links for PSB/UCO/KVB ELITE all point at the Bank of Maharashtra Elite page (site data quirk). Doctor's SBI Card plain vs IMA match is uncertain.

issuers.notes: Read with plain GET: https://www.icici.bank.in/personal-banking/cards/credit-card (redirect from icicibank.com; 23 tiles parsed from the card grid with their button states), each linked card page, the business-card and corporate-card pages, the NRI card page, and the credit-card MITC PDF (title 'MITC', 'Last updated on Nov 6th, 2026'). 'Coral RuPay' (/coral-rupay-card) and 'RuPay Credit Card' share one 'RuPay UPI Credit Card' page; the MITC says cards have the same pricing irrespective of network variant, so they are treated as network variants of Coral, not separate cards. The listing page also has a card-type dropdown inside an enquiry form that names Diamant, Corporate Gold/Platinum, CTA, Business AMEX Ascent/Essential, Gold Business, Business Platinum, Business Blue/Black Advantage; read only, nothing was typed or submitted. Missing items tagged [business] / [corporate] in evidence. Manchester United cards are matched live: not in the grid, but in the MITC and on the site (NRI page, card data path). offered_count = distinct cards across grid, linked pages, business/corporate pages, NRI page and MITC.
